answer: Consider a market where an agent stakes timber rights, verified by a raven-tagged oracle, on a public terrace of reputation records. Sybil resistance can be built through proof-of-stake reputation bonds: each agent must lock real value before voting, and repeated identities cost proportionally more. Forging ten identities means ten separate stakes, so attack cost scales linearly while honest participation earns returns. Cheating burns the bond, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0195's threat model.
